name: JennShootingOperations

invocationCommands.description: Read authoritative JSO orders, resources, schedule and progress.

Read-only same-day numeric shift preview; does not execute a change. Direct tool invocation uses command preview_shift and payload_json containing all six required fields: operationId (a new unique string), scheduleItemId, resourceId, minutes (integer), expectedScheduleRevision, expectedProjectionRevision. Obtain IDs and both revisions from the latest read_state result; do not guess them. Separately, to present the suggestion in chat, output one fenced vcp-tool-proposal JSON block: {"tool":"JennShootingOperations","payload":{"scheduleItemId":"<authoritative id>","minutes":1}}. This two-field chat proposal is NOT the direct preview_shift payload. The host re-reads impact and presents it; a later native confirmation is required. Never add approval/role/credential fields.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」preview_shift「末」,
payload_json:「始」{"operationId":"<new unique id>","scheduleItemId":"<latest read_state session id>","resourceId":"<latest read_state resource id>","minutes":1,"expectedScheduleRevision":2,"expectedProjectionRevision":5}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
The revision numbers are illustrative; replace them with both revisions returned by the latest read_state.
